note: The branch-protection state main is EXPECTED to have, committed so it can be checked instead of described. tools/check_repo_state.py compares this against live GitHub and refuses on drift. Written for the eighth audit's H-04, which found SEVEN documents still asserting main had no protection nine days after it was turned on - one of them stating the command, its output and a verification date. Prose about repository settings goes stale silently; this does not. Any change to protection must move this file in the same pull request, which is the same discipline current_state.json already carries for pull requests.

deliberately_excluded.AI-surface inventory gate: Carries a `paths:` filter (.github/workflows/ai-surface.yml:9-15), so it does not report on a pull request that touches no Rust. GitHub treats a skipped required context as PENDING, so requiring it as-is would block every merge that does not touch apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**. It can be required once the filter is removed or a no-op guard job reports in its place.
deliberately_excluded.Trust provisioning + audit signer (both: T-023. An intermittent custody refusal on the runner's inherited ACL, observed on PR #125, #132 and #148. The job's own failure text says a custody assertion failing there is a real refusal rather than an elevated-token artefact, which is exactly why it must not become a context everyone learns to rerun. Requiring it before the ACL is characterised would make the flake close main.
deliberately_excluded.Windows · §0.W broker syscall proof (nam: Made required on 2026-08-18 and it failed the same day, on a SECOND distinct Windows flake: `head_sequence::tests::concurrent_allocations_never_return_the_same_number` panicked with `head-sequence counter unreadable ... Access is denied. (os error 5)` while 106 other tests in the same binary passed. Read the code before concluding: `read_hint` (win-live/src/head_sequence.rs) treats NotFound as 0 and refuses every other error DELIBERATELY - its own comment says a mark that stops existing must not read as no-mark-required - so the refusal is correct and uniqueness is preserved. What is not robust is liveness: on Windows a concurrent writer briefly excludes readers, and the allocation fails rather than serialising. That is T-039, and it must not be closed with a retry loop around a floor read without deciding whether a retry weakens the floor. Excluded until it is characterised - which is the same rule T-023 gets, applied consistently, because the eighth audit's H-06 is precisely that the two decisions were pointing opposite ways.
